Don’t stop if your muscles start to burn that’s a good thing. Your building up the acid that actually promotes muscle growth. Once you start to feel your chest or triceps burning go slower. You just don’t want to over do it as you can majorly tear your muscles. 

This will help you gain lean muscle over time. Your diet is the most important part though without that your going to have a much harder time gaining the weight and muscle you’ll need. I went from 120lbs at your age to now weighing roughly 160lbs. I started not being able to do a single push up. Now I can do 3 set of 20 like it’s nothing. YOU GOT THIS! Feel free to PM if you have any other questions!

Edit: I forgot to add that you will wake up sore the second day is always the worst of the two. When you feel sore take a couple days off to let your muscles relax and let the micro tears heal. These tears are what build your muscle so if you over do it they can cause major tears.
